Mightora Roadmaps editor

Create a roadmap with connected workstreams

Mightora Roadmaps is a free browser tool for planning activities, dates and dependencies across multiple workstreams. It supports Markdown and CSV transfers, saved local workspaces, and read-only snapshot links.

Start with an industry example

Select “Choose an industry example” in the editor. Preview the example and create a copy. Existing roadmaps stay intact.

  • Chemistry: safer coatings from research to market
  • Manufacturing: predictive maintenance
  • Energy: community solar project
  • Power Platform: low-code app factory

Edit quarters and workstreams

Use “Edit quarters & settings” to change the start date, title, number of quarters (4–12) and quarter labels. Changing the start date shifts activity dates. A shorter horizon must still fit every activity. Use “Workstreams” to add, rename, recolour, reorder or remove rows. Activities from a populated row must be moved into another row before removal.

Connect activities

Each cell can contain several activities. Select a card to edit dates, owner, status and prerequisites. Dependencies can cross workstreams. Circular dependencies are rejected. Prerequisites must be complete before an activity moves to In progress or Done. Date overlaps are flagged for review.

Import and export

Select Markdown or CSV beside Export to download a single roadmap. “Import roadmap” validates the file and asks before replacing the current roadmap. “Data backup” transfers the whole workspace, including history and templates, with an add or replace preview. Markdown tables are summaries; the JSON restore block is authoritative. Roadmap CSV uses editable settings, workstream and activity rows. Complete workspace CSV uses JSON record cells.

Share with a team

“Share link” generates a compressed read-only snapshot. Anyone with the link can read the included content and save an independent copy. Later changes need a new link. Permanent synchronized publication is not implemented.

Where is my data stored?

Your workspace stays in browser storage on this device. Export backups to move it or protect against clearing storage. Local notes and reviews do not synchronize to other people. The public examples and catalog contain only illustrative data, never your workspace.
